label: preparing
what: A coordinated 200-loaf gathering in the town hall at eighteen, concealed behind a lighting review. Builder arranged the review and personally accepted a 101-emerald debt; baker, innkeeper and freight arranged bread supplies and deliveries. Secretary has assisted with scheduling and tracking deliveries and commitments, though knowledge of the hidden purpose is uncertain. It may celebrate my forty years as mayor, but that purpose is speculation. Neighbour's presence near the hall is suggestive, not sufficient to establish involvement.
